description.narrative: The Partners for Water 2022-2027 programme is carried out by the Netherlands Enterprise Agency. Partners for Water 2022-2027 contributes towards the Netherlands International Water Ambition of the Netherlands government.The goal of the Netherlands International Water Ambition is to provide water safety and water security in the World of humans, animals and plants, and optimise the Netherlands contribution to this and the Netherlands earning capacity.Partners for Water issues grants, as well as contracts.Funding for this programme is provided by the Netherlands Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management, as opposed to other programmes reporting in the Project Database, which are funded by the Netherlands Ministry of Foreign Affairs.For more information: Partners for Water
